entries.rationale: Vierzehn stabile Pakete nach explizitem Pilotauftrag; historische Evidence und menschliche Entscheidungen bleiben erhalten. / Fourteen stable packages under explicit pilot authority; preserve history and human decisions.
readerPaths: README -> current bounded rollout report -> release/source/installed bindings -> exact-head human review
entries.navigationImpact: README links the new technical rollout report; historical reports remain unchanged.
entries.languageStrategy: Deutsch zuerst und gleichwertiges Englisch im selben Dokument / German first and equivalent English in the same document.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Exact Bash/PowerShell matrix, archive comparison, stable routing/documentation tests; full local and native results recorded in rollout PR.
entries.risk: Package installation and technical gates grant no product, risk or human acceptance; no models or wider rollout.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Package, source, profile, evidence or authority drift.
